The world is broken and The Devouring consumes what remains. Only the Primals, heroes forged through trauma and bound by elemental power, can push back the Void.

UnGodly is a dark fantasy action RPG built around real-time combat, meaningful daily progression, and character bonds that shape both power and story.

FEATURES

Brutal Real-Time Combat
No idle autoplay. Dodge, swap, and strike with precision. Chain ultimates and elemental combos in fast, heavy battles where every decision matters.

Collect and Evolve Primals
Recruit powerful heroes, each with unique combat roles, elemental abilities, and personal histories. Upgrade skills, awaken new talents, and refine gear to build the team that fits your strategy.

Build and Customize Your Team
Experiment with elemental synergies, role combinations, and ability builds to counter different enemies and boss encounters. Depth rewards mastery.

A Mature Dark Fantasy Narrative
Explore Dunmiir, a world scarred by greed, cults, and collapse. Experience cinematic story missions and character arcs shaped by loss, loyalty, and ambition.

A Daily Dark Adventure
Short, meaningful sessions built around quests, bosses, and evolving corruption event

Autobots and Decepticons stand united against the Chaos Legion! Experience an all-new Transformers Strategy Idle RPG featuring an original story by Simon Furman!

The Earth has been consumed by a mysterious force born from pure chaos energy—an unstoppable corruption now spreading toward humanity’s final line of defense.
For generations, Autobots and Decepticons have waged an unrelenting war. But in the face of the Chaos Legion—as heroes and villains fight against the chaos—old enmities must be set aside. 
The fight for Earth is no longer about victory. It is about survival.

◆ Forge an Original Transformers Epic with Simon Furman ◆ 
Transformers: Eternal War features an original story written by Simon Furman, the legendary writer who helped define the Transformers universe for generations of fans.
In this all-new chapter, players will uncover the rise of the Chaos Legion, an apocalyptic faction empowered by unstable chaos energy. As its influence spreads, iconic Autobots and Decepticons must unite against a corruption threatening Earth, Cybertron, and the future of the universe.

Hamam Böceği Evreni'ne hoş geldin! Tek uygulamada dört komik ve hızlı oyun seni bekliyor.

HAMAM BÖCEĞİ DİVADAN KAÇ!
Diva peşinde, kaçış başladı! İstiklal Caddesi'nde koş, şerit değiştir, tramvaylardan ve engellerden kurtul: üstlerinden zıpla, altlarından kay. Topladığın cipslerle Bebek Sahil Yolu, Dolmabahçe Caddesi ve E-5 Otoyolu haritalarını aç. Ne kadar uzağa kaçabileceksin? Yakalanırsan... sonucuna katlanırsın!
• Sağa-sola kaydır: şerit değiştir
• Yukarı kaydır: zıpla
• Aşağı kaydır: altından kay

HAMAM BÖCEĞİ DÖV!
Evine giren hamam böceğine haddini bildir! Yumruk, tokat, tekme, sopa... Marketten yeni dövme şekilleri al: KONGO ve "BURALARI Bİ AYDINLAT HELE!".

DİVA DÖV!
Sıra Diva'da! Bakalım kim daha dayanıklı? Diva'nın lafları da cabası.

FLAPPY HAMAM BÖCEĞİ
Ekrana dokun, kanat çırp, borulara çarpmadan ilerle. Her geçişte cips kazan. Basit ama bırakması zor!

ÖZELLİKLER
• Dört farklı oyun modu, tek uygulama
• Kısa ve eğlenceli oyunlar: beklerken, yolda, molada
• Sıralama: nickini seç, koşu ve Flappy rekorlarınla Türkiye sıralamasına gir
• Market: cipslerle haritalar, dövme şekilleri ve hamam böceği renkleri
• Kolay kontroller, her modda en yüksek skorunu kır
• Hem iPhone hem

Hangi Kapı, seçimlerinle ilerleyen etkileşimli bir hikaye oyunudur. Hikayeyi izlemezsin, sen yazarsın.

Her sahnede önüne iki kapı çıkar. Hangisini açacağına sen karar verirsin. Bir kapı seni hikayenin devamına taşır, öbürü bambaşka bir sona. Her yolu sen seçersin, her sonu sen yaşarsın.

Uygulamada gerilimden gizeme, korkudan dramaya birbirinden farklı onlarca dizi var ve her hafta yenileri ekleniyor. Her dizinin kendi hikayesi, kendi karakterleri ve bulunmayı bekleyen birden fazla sonu var.

• Seçimli oynanış: her karar hikayeyi değiştirir
• Birden fazla son: farklı kapıları dene, gizli sonları bul
• Yanlış kapıyı mı seçtin? Geri sar, başka bir yol dene
• Onlarca dizi, her hafta yeni bölümler
• Anlatıcı sesiyle ya da sessiz oyna
• Sonlar koleksiyonu ve ödül anahtarları
• Haftalık sıralama ve ligler: arkadaşlarınla yarış
• Günlük anahtar ve seri ödülleri
• İsteğe bağlı Apple ya da Google ile giriş: ilerlemen yedeklenir, telefon değiştirince geri gelir

Sesi aç, hikayeye gir ve ilk kapını seç.

Kapı Kulübü (isteğe bağlı abonelik): tüm bölümler açık, reklamsız oyun ve her hafta bonus anahtar. Haftalık ve aylık seçenekler vardır. Ödeme, satın alma onaylandığında Apple Kimliği hesabın

SCRAM is the #1 hide and seek game for the real world. Split into hunters and runners, start the clock, and play across your street, park, campus or campsite, with your phone keeping score.

HOW IT WORKS
• Runners get a head start to hide.
• Every few minutes the hunters get a ping: each runner's location pops up on their map, marked with how long ago it was.
• Each team sees its own players live. Between pings the hunters are guessing, and runners never see the hunters at all.
• The play zone shrinks as the clock runs down. Stay outside it for 30 seconds and the hunters see you live. Stay out for 2 minutes and you're out.
• Tag someone in person and they tap "I got tagged".

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic: tagged runners are out and watch the rest of the round live. The hunters try to tag everyone, and any runner still free when time runs out wins.
• Infection: every tag switches sides. Tagged runners join the hunters, so the hunt grows as the round goes on. Survive the clock to win.
The host picks the mode, and can change it in the lobby.

YOU SET THE RULES

Build your own loft in Pigeon Online World. Feed, breed and fly your pigeons.

• Real breeds: Mardin, Adana, Posta, Kelebek, Dönek, Trakya Roller and hundreds more
• Release your kit from the rooftop, watch their tumbles and dives, whistle them back home
• Breed from egg to squab, with pedigrees and genetics
• Furnish your loft with feeders, drinkers, nest boxes and more
• Buy and sell birds in the auction hall
• Share the same sky with the other keepers in your neighbourhood
• Catch stray birds, and join contests and federation rounds

Note: On first launch the game downloads its content (about 900 MB). Wi-Fi is recommended.

A phone is a silent witness.
It remembers what its owner never told anyone.
Now it's on your desk, locked. The case is yours.

You're the new detective. Every case comes with a phone: the victim's, the missing person's, a suspect's or a witness's. The truth is in there, scattered. No one will tell you what matters.

OPEN THE PHONE
Messages, photos, voice notes, notes, emails, call logs, map history, bank transactions. You browse it like a real phone, and every app holds a piece of its owner's life. Some doors are locked: work out the passcode from the evidence, or plug in the code cracker and wait.

QUESTION THEM
Text the people in the case. Each has a voice, a secret and a lie of their own. Their replies are voiced by AI, but the truth of the case is fixed: no one confesses to something you haven't found. When you catch a lie, put the evidence in front of them.
With Premium, call a character and question them with your own voice.

WORK THE EVIDENCE
In the lab, enhance a photo, isolate a voice in the background, recover deleted data, pull cell tower records. Pin the evidence to the board and pull the red string between two pieces.

Welcome to Foodie Pop! - The perfect blend of cozy cooking simulation and satisfying match-and-serve puzzle gameplay. Many hungry customers are lining up to enjoy the delicious food you make. 
Your mission? Simply choose the right ingredients - the rest of the cooking happens automatically!

HOW TO PLAY: 
- Check what your cute customers order
- Match the right ingredients from the puzzle grid
- Watch them cook automatically in ovens, blenders, grills & more
- Serve the finished dish and keep your customers smiling!
More and more customers are piling up! Serve them fast and in order to keep everyone satisfied. Don't let them get angry and leave!

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT:
- Meet a whole cast of lovable pet characters
- Relaxing ASMR-style cooking sounds make every order satisfying to watch
- Cook a huge variety of dishes - donuts, cupcakes, burgers, fries, drinks, and more
- Addictive puzzle mechanics that combine matching with time management
- Upgrade your kitchen and unlock new ingredients, serve orders faster
- Progress through days with increasing challenges that keep gameplay fresh
- 2x speed mode so you can play at your own pace
- Unlock new ingredients, recipes, and kitchen areas

Projeto Grau 2 é o jogo de moto de quebrada: suba na sua moto, empine no grau e rode por uma cidade aberta cheia de trânsito, trabalho e perseguição.

GRAU DE VERDADE
• Empine, segure o grau e controle no acelerador: fechou o gás, a frente desce.
• Stoppie, borrachão e manobras com o piloto reagindo em cada movimento.
• Cuidado com o para-barro: raspar no asfalto tem consequência.

CIDADE ABERTA
• Trânsito com carros andando pelas ruas, dia e noite, chuva e sol.
• GPS no mapa, minimapa e celular do personagem com aplicativos.
• Modo foto com drone para registrar o seu grau.

TRAMPO PARA GANHAR DINHEIRO
• Entregas de delivery e encomendas.
• Colheita de frutas, lenhador e eletricista.
• Autoescola para tirar a habilitação.

GARAGEM E OFICINA
• Várias motos e carros para comprar ou alugar.
• Personalize rodas, som e visual na oficina.
• Dinamômetro para medir o desempenho da sua moto.

POLÍCIA NA COLA
• Fuja das viaturas, escape do nível de procura e não deixe te pegarem.


Jogo gratuito com anúncios.

The world is shrouded in crime. Cities teem with gangs, smuggling rings, and assassin syndicates — citizens live in fear. As the newly appointed police chief, you must start small and strategically expand a local precinct while safeguarding the city. Grow your reputation step by step: expand office space, establish new departments, streamline paperwork, recruit elite officers, and equip your team with top-tier gear to tackle increasingly complex cases. Transform a modest station into a prestigious law enforcement headquarters!

1. Design & Build Your Police HQ
Build an empire of justice from the ground up! Freely arrange facilities such as interrogation rooms, holding cells, and armories to optimize investigations. Every brick you lay brings the city closer to order.

2. Recruit Officers & Upgrade Gear
Assemble a dream team of elite officers to dismantle criminal schemes. Invest resources in advanced weaponry and vehicles to handle escalating threats.

3. Investigate Cases Strategically
